resources.string: Shows the prayer card when a prayer\'s time begins, keeps Home on the normal home, brings an AirPlay phone\'s picture to the TV and goes back to Home when it disconnects, keeps the Chromecast ready and hidden from phones while the TV is off, and keeps casting awake. For that it reads the AirPlay receiver\'s screen, which app is in front, whether the TV shows this input, which kinds of sound play and that focus moved, and as the TV comes on it takes one picture of the screen to cover the stock home\'s flash; nothing is kept.
